name: Horizon Africa - Inbound AI Lead Qualification

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: $json.messaging_product, to: $json.to, type: $json.type, text: { body: $json.text.body } }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const p = $('Process Response').first().json;
return { json: { phone_number: p.phoneNumber, contact_name: p.contactName, incoming_message: p.incomingMessage, ai_response: p.aiResponse, lead_score: p.leadScore, objection_type: p.objectionType, follow_up_requested: p.followUpRequested, follow_up_date: p.followUpDate, needs_escalation: p.needsEscalation, timestamp: p.timestamp } };

nodes.name: Upsert Lead
nodes.notes: Upserts lead data to Supabase leads table with follow-up fields. Uses phone_number as conflict key.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ inbox_id: $json.inboxId, source_id: $json.phoneNumber.replace('+', ''), contact_id: $json.id || null, status: 'open', assignee_id: null }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ content: $('Prepare Chatwoot Handover').first().json.conversationSummary, message_type: 'outgoing', private: true }) }}

nodes.name: Advance Lead Status
nodes.notes: Atomically advances lead status new/null -> contacted via conditional PATCH. Never overwrites statuses set by campaign classification (lost/qualified/etc).

nodes.name: Verify AI Response
nodes.notes: Fact-checks the AI reply against the live product catalog before it is sent. Flags incorrect prices, speeds, attribution, and overpromises.

nodes.name: Build Correction Request
nodes.notes: Loops the flagged reply back to the model with the authoritative catalog and the list of issues to fix.

nodes.name: Build Safe Fallback
nodes.notes: Retry budget exhausted — sends a safe holding message and escalates to a consultant instead of sending unverified info.

nodes.name: Call Jev Verifier
nodes.notes: Jev (typesafe/jev-1.13) semantic verification — judges whether the reply's facts, prices and claims are correct before sending.

nodes.name: Evaluate Jev Verdict
nodes.notes: Reads Jev probabilities; reply is unsafe if any question scores below 0.6.

nodes.name: Update Lead Score
nodes.notes: Atomic lead_score update. WHERE enforces score_locked=not.is.true plus the rank-policy `or` clause from Process Response — evaluated at write time so a stale Fetch Lead read can never bypass a manual lock or downgrade protection.
